name: Venn Test USD Paced Merchant Allowance
description: Pay a preselected merchant in a fungible CashToken, at most one capped payment per interval of blocks. The envelope carries Chipnet BCH for network fees and token outputs.

operator.name: Operator
operator.description: Anyone can trigger one capped payment per interval or, after the refund height, send the remainder to the fixed sponsor address.

pay.name: Pay merchant
pay.description: Pay an amount within the cap, at most once per interval, and carry the same allowance forward.

refund.name: Refund remainder
refund.description: Send the remaining allowance to the sponsor once the refund height permits it.

payment.name: Merchant payment
payment.description: Preserves the remaining allowance and pays the merchant.

refund.name: Allowance refund
refund.description: Closes the envelope and pays its remaining BCH to the sponsor.

paymentInput.name: Current allowance
paymentInput.description: A fungible CashToken envelope with a separate BCH reserve for network costs. It must be at least one payment interval old.

refundInput.name: Current allowance
refundInput.description: A fungible CashToken envelope with a separate BCH reserve for network costs.

allowance.name: Remaining allowance
allowance.description: The same allowance and category, less the payment and network cost.

merchantPayment.name: Merchant payment
merchantPayment.description: Test dollars in the fixed CashToken category paid to the merchant.

sponsorRefund.name: Sponsor refund
sponsorRefund.description: Remaining test dollars and the unused BCH reserve, less the fixed fee.

allowanceLock.name: Venn allowance covenant
allowanceLock.description: A P2SH32 CashToken envelope with a fixed merchant, payment cap in cents, one payment per interval of blocks, and timelocked sponsor refund.

scripts.allowanceRedeem:
OP_TXINPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
/* Require a 32-byte category and a positive fungible amount. The demo uses an FT-only genesis. */
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_SIZE <32> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_DROP
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENAMOUNT OP_0 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY
/* The path selector is exactly 0 (refund) or 1 (pay), so nobody can rewrite it and change the txid. */
OP_DUP OP_0 OP_2 OP_WITHIN OP_VERIFY
OP_IF payMerchant OP_ELSE refundSponsor OP_ENDIF
scripts.payMerchant:
/* One payment per interval: this envelope must be at least paymentInterval blocks old. */
<paymentInterval> OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY OP_DROP
OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_2 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <0xaa20> OP_ACTIVEBYTECODE OP_HASH256 OP_CAT <0x87> OP_CAT OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_1 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <merchantLock> OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_DUP OP_0 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY
<paymentCap> OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_0 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_ADD OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENAMOUNT OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
OP_1 OP_OUTPUTVALUE <1000> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE <2000> OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE <2000> OP_SUB OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_NUMEQUAL
scripts.refundSponsor:
<refundHeight> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP
OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <refundLock> OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENAMOUNT OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENAMOUNT OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_DUP <1000> OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE <1000> OP_SUB OP_NUMEQUAL

merchantLock.name: Merchant script
merchantLock.description: Fixed Chipnet P2PKH destination for payments.

refundLock.name: Sponsor script
refundLock.description: Fixed Chipnet P2PKH destination for the refund.

refundHeight.name: Refund height
refundHeight.description: Earliest transaction locktime for a sponsor refund, expressed as a block height.

paymentInterval.name: Payment interval
paymentInterval.description: Blocks that must pass after the previous payment (or the funding) before the next payment. Each payment restarts the interval.

cashBalance.name: Network cost reserve
cashBalance.description: Exact value in satoshis of the allowance output being spent.

tokenBalance.name: Allowance balance in cents
tokenBalance.description: Fungible token units on the input.

category.name: CashToken category
category.description: Category from the fixed-supply Chipnet token genesis.
